## Problem

What are you trying to understand or accomplish? Include the WAN Observer version, router model and firmware when relevant.

## Proposed behavior

Describe the useful outcome, hardware constraints and alternatives considered. Explain whether it needs extra network traffic, storage or an external service.

## Current behavior

If setup/readiness is relevant, list only sanitized status/check names or error codes. Never attach passwords, tokens, SSH keys, router backups, private addresses, raw results, real history or private configuration. Use synthetic examples.
